tools.name: weather_get_forecast
tools.description: Get the daily weather forecast for a city. Use it when the user asks about weather or whether an outdoor event should be moved. Returns one entry per day with the high, low, and chance of rain.

units.description: Unit system for temperatures: metric (Celsius) or imperial (Fahrenheit)

days.description: Number of forecast days to return

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search the user's calendar events by free-text query. Use it to find existing events before creating or changing one. Returns at most 20 events ordered by start time.

query.description: Words to match against event titles and notes, e.g. 'design review'

time_range.description: Only return events inside this window

start.description: ISO 8601 start, or null for no lower bound

tags.description: Tags the event must have; use an empty list for no tag filter

organizer.description: Organizer email address, or null for any organizer

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a new event on the user's primary calendar and send invitations. Only call it after the user has confirmed the title, time, and attendees. Returns the new event id.

attendees.description: Attendee email addresses; use an empty list for a private event

minutes_before.description: Minutes before the start time, e.g. 15

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List the calendars the signed-in user can read. Use it to find a calendar id before searching or creating events. Returns each calendar's id and display name.
